name: Scroll Metamagic
body:
You can add metamagic effects to spells read from scrolls.

Prerequisites: Spellcraft 5 ranks

Benefit: When casting a spell from a scroll, you may apply one metamagic effect you know to the spell. If the metamagic increases the spell’s level over that of a spell you could normally cast, you must make a caster level check to successfully cast the spell.
